findings.summary: Formal workers now revalidate and bind to the exact approved eight-job smoke plan, commit, input manifest, result records, and worker preflights.
Aggregation and rendering reject approval-record byte drift, uppercase/noncanonical SHA-256, path escape, duplicate smoke paths, and cross-axis approval mixing.
The structured archive scanner rejects short quoted secrets under credential-like JSON keys while retaining only explicit redaction placeholders.
Formal MATH grading provenance identifies full generated text as the Math-Verify input and forbids ambiguous extracted_answer grading fields.
Eviction applicability/firing and FullKV pooled compression statistics now have unambiguous exact schemas.
BlockQuant is retained only at its applicable three-bit point, device is fingerprinted, and formal zero-shot results require cuda:0.
